metadata.venue: MetLife Stadium, East Rutherford, New Jersey

ai_summary.key_headline: Clash of Styles: Spain's Collective vs. Messi's Genius
tactical_insights: Rodri and Pedri's midfield control will be crucial to disrupt Argentina's attempts to get the ball to Messi.
Spain enters the final on a 37-game unbeaten streak, showcasing formidable defensive solidity throughout the tournament.
The final pits Spain's possession-dominant collective against Argentina's blend of tactical discipline and Messi's individual brilliance.
